description.value: Indian Grill is a North Indian and Punjabi restaurant at the corner of Milton and Albert Streets in downtown Nanaimo, serving dishes freshly made with traditional spices including tandoori items pulled from a clay oven, biryanis, and creamy curries. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, online ordering, and catering, and has earned a 95%+ quality score and a ranking among the top 1% of Canadian restaurants in its category. Its central downtown location makes it a practical meal stop for cyclists passing through Nanaimo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (indiangrillnanaimo.ca) is live and provides the address (507 Milton St, Nanaimo, BC V9R 2L2) and phone ((250) 802-3940) not present in OSM tags. The site explicitly confirms dine-in, takeout, and delivery, and lists multiple vegetarian dishes (Aloo Gobhi, Dal Makhani, Vegetable Mixed Pakora, Chole Bhature). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Indian Grill's' (with apostrophe-s) but the website consistently uses 'Indian Grill' throughout all pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating dine-in restaurant in downtown Nanaimo with a live website, confirmed address, and active online ordering. A practical meal stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegetarian dishes listed: Aloo Gobhi, Dal Makhani, Vegetable Mixed Pakora, Chole Bhature, Amritsari Kulcha. No vegan or GF claims confirmed

wow_evidence: 95%+ quality score and a ranking among the top 1% of Canadian restaurants in its category
